title: Gateway answer to an agent schild.agent_ack/0.1 (v0.3, MVP-11)
description: The only thing the gateway ever sends back to an agent (POST /v0/agent/report and /v0/agent/enrol, TLS). It is an acknowledgement, never an instruction: there is no field for commands, intervals or configuration, and agents ignore everything but status, error and retry_after_s. Unsigned; the agent authenticates the gateway by its pinned TLS certificate. See host-check.md section 6.

status.description: accepted: stored. duplicate: this nonce was already stored. pending: enrolment received, waits for confirmation in the dashboard. rejected: see error, do not resend the same message. retry: try again after retry_after_s (gateway busy).

nonce.description: Nonce of the request this answers.

error.description: Contract error code when rejected, else null.

retry_after_s.description: Backoff hint for status retry only; agents cap it at 86400.
